Aisha (CS): Weekly health check-in: p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming. Quick topline: streaming generally lowers p95 but some routes have non-stream p99 tail. Posting snapshot + flags. Please respond if you own a route.

metrics-bot: snapshot 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC
Route /summarize — streaming p95 120ms p99 470ms | non-stream p95 190ms p99 920ms
Route /qa — streaming p95 250ms p99 1600ms | non-stream p95 420ms p99 3400ms
Model redwood-3b — streaming p95 110ms p99 430ms
Model redwood-7b-q — non-stream p95 210ms p99 1250ms
Errors: /qa error rate 0.9% (+0.4ppt w/w)
Spend: AcmePilot +18% w/w (peak tokens +26%)
Notes: small streaming sample for /qa (n=120); alert threshold exceeded for /qa p99.

Jorge (CS): Seeing same from AcmePilot. They reported slow summarization. Suggested streaming but client doesn't support it yet.

Sam - SRE: Investigated /qa spike. Rollout of redwood-7b-q on dedicated yesterday at 14:42 UTC correlated with tail increase. Rolled back to redwood-3b; p99 dropped ~60%. Possible quantization regression.

Sam - SRE: logs:
```
2026-03-20T14:41:50Z model=redwood-7b-q route=/qa p99=3400ms kv_cache_miss=0.78 batch_size=1
2026-03-20T15:05:12Z model=redwood-3b route=/qa p99=1200ms kv_cache_miss=0.33 batch_size=2
```

Maya (eng-ml): I'll re-run profiler on 7b-q quant layer. Initial quant profile looked ok but we didn't test low-batch streaming.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Can we confirm batching policy for dedicated? If batch_size collapsed to 1 for streaming that's a likely cause. I'll check autoscaler & per-route batching config.

Lena - AM: FYI — AcmePilot renewal in two weeks. If latency persists they'll request credits. Recommend short-term credits + ops deep-dive.

Aisha (CS): Action items:
- @Ravi check batching/autoscale + share config by EOD
- @Maya sanity-check quant profile for low-batch streaming (tomorrow)
- @Sam keep rollback until validated (done)
- @Lena I'll prep renewal note + propose 1:1 ops call
I'll share dashboard link after updates.
